name: LaFerrari
description: Maranello's first hybrid hypercar pairing a 6.3L naturally aspirated V12 with an F1-derived kinetic energy recovery system.

hotspots.label: 6.3L V12 + HY-KERS
hotspots.detail: 800 CV combustion engine paired with a 120 kW electric motor revving to 9,250 rpm.

hotspots.label: Active Underbody Aero
hotspots.detail: Automatically deploys front and rear diffusers and active rear wing based on telemetry.

hotspots.label: Fixed Carbon Monocoque
hotspots.detail: F1-inspired sculpted seat integrated directly into the T800 carbon-fiber tub.

name: P1
description: Engineered around a 90 kg MonoCage carbon structure with RaceActive Chassis Control and instant electric torque fill.

hotspots.label: DRS Rear Wing
hotspots.detail: Extends rearward by 300 mm in Race Mode, generating 600 kg of downforce.

hotspots.label: 3.8L M838TQ Twin-Turbo
hotspots.detail: Mid-mounted twin-turbocharged V8 coupled with an in-house lightweight e-motor.

hotspots.label: Akebono Carbon-Ceramic
hotspots.detail: Silicon-carbide coated discs engineered for repeatable track thermal dissipation.

name: 918 Spyder
description: All-wheel-drive plug-in hybrid combining a high-revving 4.6L V8 with dual electric motors and top-exit exhaust pipes.

hotspots.label: Top-Pipe Exhaust System
hotspots.detail: Directs hot exhaust gases immediately upward to keep the engine bay and battery cool.

hotspots.label: Front Axle E-Motor
hotspots.detail: Independent 95 kW electric drive unit powering the front wheels with torque vectoring.

hotspots.label: Weissach Carbon Cockpit
hotspots.detail: Floating center console with haptic glass interface and exposed matte carbon weave.
